title: Bitcoin、Ethereum 與 XRP 反彈至週高，空頭部位慘遭爆倉

summary_zh: Bitcoin 反彈突破 62,000 美元，帶動加密市場上漲，空頭部位大量爆倉。

title: FBI 局長 Kash Patel 未披露買入 Strategy 股票，持股已跌 44%
content: FBI Director Kash Patel failed to disclose a significant purchase of stock in Bitcoin treasury firm Strategy from last November.
summary_zh: FBI 局長 Kash Patel 未申報去年 11 月購入 Strategy 股票，目前已下跌 44%。

title: Standard Chartered 成為首家提供機構直接 USDC 服務的全球銀行
content: Standard Chartered is the first Global Systemically Important Bank authorized to let institutions mint and redeem Circle's USDC.
summary_zh: Standard Chartered 獲准讓機構直接 mint 與 redeem Circle USDC，為首家全球系統重要性銀行。

title: Metaplanet 在 Q2 新增 2,823 枚 Bitcoin，購買速度放緩
content: The Japanese firm's 43,000-BTC stack now sits well below its cost basis, and it has leaned on debt over equity to keep buying.
summary_zh: Metaplanet Q2 新增 2,823 枚 Bitcoin，持有量達 43,000 枚但低於成本基礎並改用債務購買。

title: Morning Minute: Robinhood Debuts 'Robinhood Chain'
content: The market liked it with HOOD shares jumping 8% and their crypto perp dex partner up even more. Plus crypto's latest unicorn is crowned.

title: Scattered Spider Suspect Extradited to US Over $8M Crypto Ransom Demand
content: The teenager allegedly helped to breach a luxury jeweler and demand $8 million in crypto, as part of a crew tied to $100 million in ransoms.

title: Trump bought Apple, Nvidia and other tech giants before tariff reversal fueled rebound
content: The day before President Donald Trump walked back his tariff policy turned out to be one of his busiest days of 2025 for stock buying.

title: Amazon has deployed enough satellites to launch Leo service later this year
content: Leo will compete with SpaceX's Starlink, which had a four-year start over Amazon and has more than 10,000 satellites in its constellation.

title: Autonomous drone startup Quantum Systems raises $1.2 billion as investors pile into defense
content: Defense tech startups are raising record amounts on both sides of the Atlantic amid a flurry of investment in the sector.

title: Job seekers giving up: Labor force participation rate falls to lowest in 50 years, outside of Covid era
content: A drop in the unemployment rate helped provide some upside to what was an otherwise downbeat jobs report — but it was for all the wrong reasons.
